name: Alekos
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Alekos in Garmisch-Partenkirchen**

Discover authentic Greek cuisine in the heart of the Alps! At **Alekos**, we bring the flavors of the Mediterranean to the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**. Indulge in fresh salads, succulent grilled meats, and delicious Greek specialties—all made with love and the finest ingredients.

Whether you're craving a hearty **Moussaka**, a crisp **Souvlaki**, or a refreshing **Tzatziki**, our menu has something for every palate. Pair your meal with a glass of crisp Greek wine or a cold **Ouzo** for the perfect dining experience.

Located in the charming village of **Garmisch-Partenkirchen**, just a short walk from the **Zugspitze**, our cozy restaurant is the ideal spot to relax after a day of adventure. Come taste the sun, even when the Alps are blanketed in snow!

**Alekos – Where Greece meets Tirol!**
beschreibung: The **Alekos** in **Garmisch-Partenkirchen** is a popular restaurant that delights its guests with a diverse menu and authentic regional hospitality. The ambiance blends traditional Tyrolean charm with modern comfort, creating a welcoming atmosphere for any occasion. The menu features carefully selected dishes—from classic Tyrolean specialties like **Tiroler Gröstl** and **Kaiserschmarrn** to international favorites. The team places special emphasis on using fresh, locally sourced ingredients from the region. Whether you're enjoying a cozy dinner for two, celebrating with family, or meeting for business, **Alekos** warmly welcomes you and ensures a memorable stay with attentive service.
